camel_example: aliyun sas BatchUpdateMaliciousFileWhitelistConfig --region cn-hangzhou --ConfigList.1.FieldValue b2cf9747ee49d8d9b105cf16e078cc16 --ConfigList.1.Field fileMd5 --ConfigList.1.EventName ALL --ConfigList.1.Source agentless --ConfigList.1.Operator strEqual --ConfigList.1.ConfigId 1 --ConfigList.1.TargetValue ALL --ConfigList.1.TargetType ALL
description_en: Modifies multiple alert whitelist rules of sensitive files that are detected by using the agentless detection feature at a time
description_zh: 批量修改无代理检测敏感文件告警加白规则
kebab_example: aliyun sas batch-update-malicious-file-whitelist-config --config-list Operator=strEqual Field=fileMd5 TargetValue=ALL TargetType=ALL ConfigId=1 EventName=ALL FieldValue=b2cf9747ee49d8d9b105cf16e078cc16 Source=agentless --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchUpdateMaliciousFileWhitelistConfig

fields.help_en: The ID of the whitelist rule. If you do not specify this parameter, a whitelist rule is created
fields.help_zh: 无代理检测敏感文件告警加白规则ID，可选，不传代表新增规则。可调用[ListMaliciousFileWhitelistConfigs](~~ListMaliciousFileWhitelistConfigs~~)获取敏感文件加白规则的ID
fields.name: config_id

fields.help_en:
The name of the alert.

Set the value to ALL, which indicates all alert types
fields.help_zh:
告警名称：
ALL： 全部告警类型
fields.name: event_name

fields.help_en: The field that you want to use in the whitelist rule
fields.help_zh: 敏感文件告警中用于加白判定的字段
fields.name: field

fields.help_en: The value of the field that you want to use in the whitelist rule
fields.name: field_value

fields.help_en:
The logical operator that you want to use in the whitelist rule.

Set the value to strEqual, which indicates the equality operator (=)
fields.help_zh:
规则判定操作符：
strEqual：字符串相等
fields.name: operator

fields.help_en:
The feature to which this operation belongs.

Set the value to agentless, which indicates the agentless detection feature
fields.help_zh:
业务来源：
agentless：无代理检测
fields.name: source

fields.help_en:
The type of the assets on which you want the whitelist rule to take effect. Valid values:

ALL: all assets
SELECTION_KEY: selected assets
fields.help_zh:
生效目标类型：
ALL：全部资产
SELECTION_KEY：通过资产选择组件选中的资产
fields.name: target_type

fields.help_en:
The assets on which you want the whitelist rule to take effect. Valid values:

ALL: all assets
Others: selected assets
fields.help_zh:
目标生效范围：
ALL：全部资产
其他：资产选择组件选中的资产范围Key
fields.name: target_value

parameters.help_zh: 无代理检测敏感文件告警加白规则列表
parameters.name: config_list
